channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Jane Doe in Cornell Lawsuit to Remain Anonymous as Judge Warns Against Threats
item.description: The judge said "the notoriety of the allegations and widespread reports of certain malicious actors' behavior" warranted anonymity.

item.title: Paris suburb shooting investigated as terrorism, officials say
item.description: A gunman fired from his car in Trappes, a Paris suburb, on Friday in what authorities called a racially motivated act of terrorism.

item.title: Father who stopped school shooter recounts: 'I was supposed to be there'
item.description: Kaylub Giamanco said he was driving home on Oct. 15 when he saw an armed person dressed in black jump the fence at the elementary school.

item.title: German teen arrested on suspicion of murder in US girl's death
item.description: Prosecutors in Germany say the 18-year-old manipulated an Indiana teen over a social platform.
